style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 2m Pre Lit Christmas Conifer & Pinecone Outdoor Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Take a rest with the uplifting ambience of the 2m Pre Lit Christmas Conifer & Pinecone Outdoor Garland. The pre lit conifer and pinecone garland goes beautifully in your home to add a dose of lush foliage to your space. The faux foliage has the beauty of a real conifer. The garland is pre lit with 50 LED lights that are programmed to come on at the same time each evening with the 6-hour timer. There is also an ‘on’ mode for constant light. Wind down under the enchanting glow. Turn off the big light and create a magic ambience with the help of the bewitching LEDs.
